ROOT CAUSE
[PRIMARY] This server's KDC (krb5kdc) is not running - confidence HIGH
krb5kdc.service is inactive.
Impact: No Kerberos ticket is issued by this server. Its GSSAPI replication agreements fail once the Directory Ser
ver's current tickets expire (if this server's Kerberos configuration names only itself); clients and other servers that
use this KDC fail over to others or fail.
Chain: this server's KDC (krb5kdc) is not running
RESOLUTION (only for causes on this server)
For 'This server's KDC (krb5kdc) is not running': Start the stopped service (risk MEDIUM; ipa-diagnose never runs it)
NO-GOOGLE: every step, its host, its expected result, what to do if it fails, backup, rollback and verification are
below, and this procedure was verified live on this FreeIPA version and OS.
✓ ipa-diagnose is running as root (starting a system service needs root)
1. On ipa01.lab.test: Start only krb5kdc.service; no other service is started or stopped
systemctl start krb5kdc.service
Expected: the command returns without an error and krb5kdc.service is active. If it fails, it stays stopped and s
ystemctl status shows why
If a step fails: If 'systemctl start' fails, the unit stays stopped and nothing else changed: read 'systemctl status
krb5kdc.service' and 'journalctl -u krb5kdc.service -n 50' (read-only) for the reason, fix that cause, and run ipa-diag
nose replication again. Do not use 'ipactl start' instead: it stops every IPA service when one of them fails to start.
What changes: krb5kdc.service goes from inactive to running. No configuration, data or other service is changed.
Backup: no backup is needed: the procedure starts a service; no file, configuration or directory data is changed
Rollback: Stop it again (back to the state it was in) -> systemctl stop krb5kdc.service
Note: This starts the one stopped service; it does not establish why it stopped. If it stopped because of a failure
(see the last result and log line above), the same cause can stop it again. ipactl start is deliberately not used: if an
y IPA service fails to start, ipactl stops all IPA services.
Verify (tied to this incident):
- krb5kdc.service is active
- This server's KDC (krb5kdc) is not running: no longer found by a fresh ipa-diagnose replication run
run: sudo ipa-diagnose replication --verify
NEXT READ-ONLY STEPS
systemctl status krb5kdc (read-only)
journalctl -u krb5kdc -n 50 (read-only)
